curated.notes: Lands matter: Omo's everything counters make lands every land type (Cloudpost, Glimmerpost and the Deserts pay off), landfall creatures finish. Forge's LANDS archetype needs 45% lands and a singleton 99 with 38 lands is 38%, so the plan is forced to LANDS (mana development in the Monte Carlo evaluator). Key cards order the land tutors (Sylvan Scrying, Expedition Map, Hour of Promise) and the creature picks: the Locus pair first, then the landfall payoffs. Dark Depths plus Thespian's Stage is in the deck but Forge's detector wants two Dark Depths, and the AI cannot resolve the Stage line anyway (Thespian's Stage is AI:RemoveDeck), so it is left out. Eight cards carry AI:RemoveDeck:All here; data cannot change how they are played.
curated.by: hand, from the decklist and Forge's plan detectors (DESIGN.md §19)

playbook.notes: The lands candidate (version 5: Omo at once, the land finders, landfall payoffs before the land, ramp, the big creatures on curve, X spells as mana sinks, the Marit Lage line, Pongify and Beast Within when threatened, Seer's Sundial's trigger) under the go-wide attack from two attackers up instead of the pressure attack. In sixty duels (seed 20261153) stock won 17, the pressure version 17 and this one 20: under pressure the seat held back more attackers than it sent (860 against 700) and dealt 25 damage a game where it deals 120 to three goldfish. Shipped 2026-11-11 after ab-run #11: on 200 new tables (seed 20261142) it wins 48 where stock wins 30, 24.0% against 15.0% (+9.0 points, 95% +2 to +16, 33 tables won only by it against 15 only by stock, exact test 0.013). With key cards for the tutors on top (Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage first) it wins 50, no different; the same rules under the pressure attack win 37 (demo-data/ab/2026-11-11-ab-v8/tricky-terrain.json, DESIGN.md §22).
